Lisa T. Su Chair, President and Chief Executive Officer 2025 1,291,258 — 41,669,390 8,951,513 3,125,430 124,188 55,161,779
ITEM 1—ELECTION OF DIRECTORS Our Board currently consists of nine members.
The Board determined that all directors who served during fiscal 2025 and all of our director nominees, other than Dr. Su, are independent in accordance with SEC and Nasdaq rules.

At our 2025 annual meeting of stockholders, our Say-on-Pay proposal received support from approximately 85% of the votes cast on the proposal, reflecting widespread stockholder support for our fiscal 2024 executive compensation program.
On the Record Date, 1,630,338,779 shares of our common stock were outstanding. Every stockholder is entitled to one vote for each share of common stock held on the Record Date.
